latest_release.name: ESP32 Arduino Release 3.3.12 based on ESP-IDF v5.5.5
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* fix(webserver): Harden security and fix hangs by @lucasssvaz in https://github.com/espressif/arduino-esp32/pull/12794
* ci(upload): Optimize scripts and upload test by @lucasssvaz in https://github.com/espressif/arduino-esp32/pull/12773
* build(deps): bump cryptography from 48.0.1 to 50.0.0 in /tests by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/espressif/arduino-esp32/pull/12804
* docs(compatibility): Add notes on ESP8266 compatibility by @lucasssvaz in https://github.com/espressif/arduino-esp32/pull/12802
* docs(adc): Correct attenuation enum names to match the Arduino API by @Rubi9981 in https://github.com/espressif/arduino-esp32/pull/12777
* fix(cmake): Add HTTPUpdateServer to Arduino library list by @ThomasMaier73 in https://github.com/espressif/arduino-esp32/pull/12786
* feat(boards): Add MInimal partitions for MakerGo C3 Supermini by @P-R-O-C-H-Y in https://github.com/espressif/arduino-esp32/pull/12791
* docs(ledc): Add info about timer sharing and frequency limits by @P-R-O-C-H-Y in https://github.com/espressif/arduino-esp32/pull/12793
* fix(ble): Fix oversized AD bounds by @lucasssvaz in https://github.com/espressif/arduino-esp32/pull/12805
* feat(board): add Waveshare ESP32-C5-Zero by @H-sw123 in https://github.com/espressif/arduino-esp32/pull/12807
* feat(board): add Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-4.3C by @H-sw123 in https://github.com/espressif/arduino-esp32/pull/12808
* feat(doc):  include Home Assistant as Matter environment by @SuGlider in https://github.com/espressif/arduino-esp32/pull/12810
* feat(uart): improve example documentation by @SuGlider in https://github.com/espressif/arduino-esp32/pull/12745
* fix(acmake): Fix cache invalidation when libs change by @lucasssvaz in https://github.com/espressif/arduino-esp32/pull/12806
* fix(zigbee): Check proper return of readAttribute and configure by @P-R-O-C-H-Y in https://github.com/espressif/arduino-esp32/pull/12799
* feat(ota): Add support for IPv6 OTA by @lucasssvaz in https://github.com/espressif/arduino-esp32/pull/12803
* feat(board): add Waveshare ESP32-C5-LCD-1.47 by @H-sw123 in https://github.com/espressif/arduino-esp32/pull/12811
* fix(littlefs): zero-init conf to avoid -Werror by @richardsonnick in https://github.com/espressif/arduino-esp32/pull/12836
* feat(esp32): added useBuiltinCACertBundle to NetworkClientSecure by @remi-ngton in https://github.com/espressif/arduino-esp32/pull/12792
* fix(cpu): Fix memory leak in getSupportedCpuFrequencyMhz by @richardsonnick in https://github.com/espressif/arduino-esp32/pull/12838
* fix(matter): fix binary sensors for Matter 1.5 by @SuGlider in https://github.com/espressif/arduino-esp32/pull/12842
* feat(update): add optional SHA-256 checksum for incoming firmware by @EyJunge1 in https://github.com/espressif/arduino-esp32/pull/12824
* feat(board): Add Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-7C-BOX board by @H-sw123 in https://github.com/espressif/arduino-esp32/pull/12812
* feat(board): Add Waveshare ESP32-S3 RGB Matrix by @H-sw123 in https://github.com/espressif/arduino-esp32/pull/12813
* feat(boards): Add Raiden S01 ESP32-S3 devkit board by @RaidenTechnology in https://github.com/espressif/arduino-esp32/pull/12835
* feat(openthread): add SRP / DNS-SD API by @SuGlider in https://github.com/espressif/arduino-esp32/pull/12818
* feat(ble): Add test cases and memory management documentation by @lucasssvaz in https://github.com/espressif/arduino-esp32/pull/12825
* fix(matter): fix light color control within Matter 1.5 by @SuGlider in https://github.com/espressif/arduino-esp32/pull/12846
* feat(matter): allow setting Matter Descriptor TagList attribute for endpoint by @lboue in https://github.com/espressif/arduino-esp32/pull/12776
* feat(httpupdate): add optional checksum sidecar URLs by @EyJunge1 in https://github.com/espressif/arduino-esp32/pull/12848
* feat(ethernet): Make W5500 polling period configurable by @sblantipodi in https://github.com/espressif/arduino-esp32/pull/12856
* fea
